title: The King and the Clever Rabbit

narrations.title: The Pompous Procession
narrations.narration: In a bright, green jungle, there lived a lion named Leonard. He believed he was the rightful King, marching with pride and a very plump belly.

narrations.title: The Clumsy King
narrations.narration: Leonard wanted everyone to bow to him, but the other animals mostly ignored him because he was incredibly clumsy.

narrations.title: Enter Remy
narrations.narration: One sunny afternoon, Remy the rabbit noticed Leonard having a comical temper tantrum because a squirrel refused to follow his royal decrees.

narrations.title: The Clever Challenge
narrations.narration: Remy stepped forward with a plan. He told Leonard about another king who claimed to be bigger and stronger.

narrations.title: Journey to the Great Well
narrations.narration: With his pride wounded, Leonard followed the little rabbit to a deep, stone well filled with clear water.

narrations.title: The Mirror Image
narrations.narration: Leonard leaned over the edge. He didn't realize he was looking at his own reflection!

narrations.title: The Royal Splash
narrations.narration: Flustered and furious, Leonard jumped right into the well with a giant splash!

narrations.title: A Lesson Learned
narrations.narration: Leonard realized he had been fooled. He learned that being a kind friend was much better than being a grumpy boss.
